title: Pete Sessions Disclosed 28 Stock Sales in One Filing, Three at $250K–$500K (Oct 2026)
content:

Member: Rep. Pete Sessions, TX-17 (House). Disclosure date: Oct 27, 2026. Every row is a sale. The data also contains one exact duplicate of the Oct 2 TJX row (1 extra row, 29 rows in all); the data cannot show whether it is a repeated record or a separate trade, so it is counted once here.

What's been disclosed

  • 28 sales in one filing: all dated between October 1 and October 27, and all disclosed on October 27.
  • Concentrated on October 2: 15 of the 28 sales are dated that day, including Microsoft, Costco and Apple at $250,001–$500,000 each and Amazon at $100,001–$250,000.
  • Combined size: adding the lower and upper ends of every band gives roughly $1.24 million to $2.92 million. This is arithmetic on bands, not actual proceeds.
  • One odd row: Resideo (REZI) is listed with an exact amount of $344.99 rather than a band.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts 21 of the 28 stocks higher on October 28 than on the sale date and 7 lower.
  • Related filings: the same member's earlier disclosures are in this post and this one.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
The earliest sale in this filing (October 1) was disclosed 26 days later and the latest (October 27) the same day. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 28 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
